summary: No eligible Industrial Dallas single-asset acquisitions between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31 met all criteria. Most Dallas records were amended to Seattle; others failed contact currency/verification, role requirements, size/date thresholds, or were excluded categories (broker/manager/announced bid/portfolio total). A prospect CSV with headers has been created; no rows were added due to zero qualifying sponsors.
limitations: Only the supplied extracts and updates were considered; no external verification was performed.
Several entities had conflicting or duplicate records; entity-level amendments were applied across duplicates as instructed.
One potential candidate (R4391) was excluded because its base evidence was published after the cutoff date, despite an in-window event date.
If additional current contacts (CFO/Head of Acquisitions/Director of Finance) exist but were not in the provided evidence, they could change eligibility.
